name: Breath Weapon
description:
You can naturally exhale a burst of a volatile energy or substance.

Once per rest: Roll Fortitude vs Dexterity against a creature within short range. On a win, you deal damage equal to half your BODY score in d6s (minimum 1d6). On a loss, half damage.

The nature of your breath weapon is based on your Draconic Affinity. If you do not have the Draconic Affinity trait, choose a volatile energy or substance for the purpose of this ability, but you do not gain the protective benefits of that affinity: whenever you deal damage with this ability, you also take that amount of damage, halved.

Describe the burst and its effects.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: You may target any number of creatures within short range.
